##### Project general facts

Acacia Park Heights is a residential development by Emaar Properties, offering one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each with a private outdoor balcony. The building is designed with clean, contemporary lines executed in high-quality materials, complemented by ultra-modern detailing throughout. The project reflects Emaar Properties' design-led approach to residential living. Surrounded by landscaped spaces and an expansive park, it creates a serene and well-balanced living environment.

The development offers a lifestyle enriched by a wide range of amenities and outdoor experiences. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, children’s play areas, and beautifully designed courtyards, while ground-floor retail includes supermarkets, cafés, and everyday conveniences. Just moments away, Dubai Hills Park provides extensive leisure options, including a lagoon, water park, sports courts, jogging tracks, picnic areas, and dedicated spaces for relaxation and recreation.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials and an ultra-modern design, incorporating technological detailing throughout each residence, and every apartment includes a private outdoor balcony. Large windows and spacious balconies with transparent railings allow for abundant natural light and open views, while high-quality finishes ensure a modern and elegant feel throughout. The residences are delivered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills is a prestigious and vibrant master-planned community located in the heart of Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding, it represents a harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design.

At the heart of Dubai Hills is the stunning 18-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards. The golf course adds a touch of greenery and serenity to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world.

Dubai Hills is not just a residential development - it's a comprehensive lifestyle destination. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Residents and visitors can also enjoy the Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation.
